answer.reason: The verses tell of Asa's battle with Zerah, his removal of Maachah's idol, and his dealings with Benhadad against Baasha.

clauses.english: defeated Zerah the Ethiopian when the LORD smote the Ethiopians
clauses.quote: the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa

clauses.english: removed his mother Maachah from being queen and burnt her idol
clauses.quote: Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron

clauses.english: sent silver and gold to Benhadad of Syria to turn him against Baasha
clauses.quote: king Asa sent them to Benhadad

doubts: Left out the covenant at Jerusalem (2CH 15:10-12) and the disease in his feet (2CH 16:12) to keep to three clauses.
Left out 1KI 15:25-33, 1KI 16, 1KI 22:41, 2CH 17:2, 2CH 20:32, 2CH 21:12 and MAT 1:7-8, which only date other reigns or mention Asa in passing.
